newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nissan says stake possible in S.Africa Automakers.
newsitem.headline: Nissan says stake possible in S.Africa Automakers.

text.p: Nissan Motor president Yoshikazu Hanawa said on Friday that it was possible his company would take a stake in South Africa's Automakers Ltd.
Asked if Nissan planned to take a stake in Automakers, as has been speculated in the South African media, Hanawa said: "It is possible, but we have not made a decision."
Shares in Automakers soared on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange last week on rumours that Nissan and Italy's Fiat SpA were contemplating taking a stake in the carmaker.
Last October, Toyota Motor Corp bought a 27.8 percent stake in Toyota South Africa Ltd for 446 million rand. The company is 50 percent owned by Wesco, an independent South African Holding Company.
